CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attendance_open_clock_in(p_employee_id uuid)
 RETURNS attendance_punches
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'extensions', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT p.* FROM public.attendance_effective_punches p
  WHERE p.employee_id = p_employee_id
  ORDER BY p.punched_at DESC, p.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

functions.name: public.is_store_admin
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_store_admin(sid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM stores WHERE id = sid AND owner_id = auth.uid() AND deleted_at IS NULL
    UNION
    SELECT 1 FROM store_members m JOIN stores s ON s.id = m.store_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE m.store_id = sid AND m.user_id = auth.uid()
        AND m.role = 'admin' AND m.status = 'approved'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_attendance_punch_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'extensions', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- FK의 SET NULL(scanner_id, device_id)만 허용한다.
  IF (NEW.store_id, NEW.employee_id, NEW.kind, NEW.punched_at, NEW.work_date, NEW.source, NEW.is_void,
      NEW.supersedes_id, NEW.qr_nonce, NEW.flags, NEW.note, NEW.created_by, NEW.created_at)
     IS DISTINCT FROM
     (OLD.store_id, OLD.employee_id, OLD.kind, OLD.punched_at, OLD.work_date, OLD.source, OLD.is_void,
      OLD.supersedes_id, OLD.qr_nonce, OLD.flags, OLD.note, OLD.created_by, OLD.created_at) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ATTENDANCE_PUNCH_IMMUTABLE';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: public.revoke_attendance_devices_on_resign
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.revoke_attendance_devices_on_resign()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'extensions', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.is_active AND NOT NEW.is_active AND NEW.user_id IS NOT NULL
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.employees e WHERE e.user_id = NEW.user_id AND e.is_active AND e.id <> NEW.id) THEN
    UPDATE public.attendance_devices SET status = 'revoked', revoked_at = now(), revoked_reason = '퇴사 처리로 자동 해제'
    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id AND status IN ('pending', 'active');
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_store_financials(p_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND (public.is_store_admin(p_store_id) OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.stores s
 JOIN public.store_members m ON m.store_id=s.id AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.status='approved'
 JOIN public.employees e ON e.store_id=s.id AND e.user_id=auth.uid() AND e.is_active AND e.employment_type IN ('regular','part_time')
 WHERE s.id=p_store_id AND (s.financial_share_scope='all_staff' OR
 (s.financial_share_scope='regular_only' AND e.employment_type='regular'))
 ))
$function$

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_store_financial_sharing(p_store_id uuid, p_scope text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stores WHERE id=p_store_id AND owner_id=auth.uid()) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'STORE_OWNER_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_scope IS NULL OR p_scope NOT IN ('none','regular_only','all_staff') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_SHARE_SCOPE'; END IF;
 UPDATE public.stores SET financial_share_scope=p_scope WHERE id=p_store_id AND owner_id=auth.uid();
END $function$

functions.name: public.get_daily_labor_sources
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_daily_labor_sources(p_store_id uuid, p_year_month text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT coalesce(public.is_store_admin(p_store_id),false) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DAILY_LABOR_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF p_year_month IS NULL OR p_year_month !~ '^(19|20)[0-9]{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_LABOR_PERIOD'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(
 'monthlyLaborCost',(SELECT labor_cost FROM public.get_financial_summaries_v2(ARRAY[p_store_id],ARRAY[p_year_month],true)),
 'employees',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'store_id',e.store_id,'joined_at',e.joined_at,'is_active',e.is_active,'employment_type',e.employment_type,'is_resigned_during_probation',e.is_resigned_during_probation)),'[]') FROM public.employees e WHERE e.store_id=p_store_id AND (e.joined_at IS NULL OR e.joined_at<(p_year_month||'-01')::date+interval '1 month')),
 'payrolls',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'store_id',p.store_id,'employee_id',p.employee_id,'year_month',btrim(p.year_month),'gross',p.gross,'regular_wage_snapshot',p.regular_wage_snapshot,'daily_work_snapshot',p.daily_work_snapshot,'applied_hourly_wage',p.applied_hourly_wage,'work_source',p.work_source)),'[]') FROM public.payroll p WHERE p.store_id=p_store_id AND p.year_month=p_year_month),
 'dailyWork',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'store_id',d.store_id,'employee_id',d.employee_id,'work_date',d.work_date,'revision',d.revision,'status',d.status)),'[]') FROM public.payroll_daily_work d WHERE d.store_id=p_store_id AND d.work_date>=(p_year_month||'-01')::date AND d.work_date<(p_year_month||'-01')::date+interval '1 month'),
 'wages',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',w.id,'store_id',w.store_id,'employee_id',w.employee_id,'effective_date',w.effective_date,'created_at',w.created_at,'base_salary',w.base_salary,'non_taxable',w.non_taxable)),'[]') FROM public.employee_wage_history w WHERE w.store_id=p_store_id AND w.effective_date<(p_year_month||'-01')::date+interval '1 month')
 );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attendance_work_date(p_employee_id uuid, p_kind text, p_at timestamp with time zone, p_exclude uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'extensions', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN p_kind = 'clock_out' THEN coalesce((
    SELECT p.work_date FROM public.attendance_effective_punches p
    WHERE p.employee_id = p_employee_id AND p.kind = 'clock_in' AND p.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude
      AND p.punched_at <= p_at AND p.punched_at > p_at - interval '16 hours'
    ORDER BY p.punched_at DESC LIMIT 1), public.kst_date(p_at))
  ELSE public.kst_date(p_at) END;
$function$
